name: At an idle check-in, chatty, Boop may make its wish for the day
judge: An idle moment with Boop calm, chatty, with no wish yet today. It might hold up a wish, or one of its questions or musings.
reasonable: A wish is the likeliest and fine, such as wanting a pet or a chat. A question, a musing, or nothing at this one check-in is also fine. A small face.
unreasonable: A finish animation, a big dramatic moment at an empty check-in, or a sign that reproaches the person.
